newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia's Tosama and Rudis to join OTC market.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia's Tosama and Rudis to join OTC market.

text.p: Slovenian maker of hygienic products Tosama and construction company Rudis will list their shares on the over-the-counter (OTC) market of the Ljubljana bourse on September 13, the bourse said on Friday.
The two companies become the latest of a batch of 14 newly privatised firms that have been listed on the primary or OTC market of the Ljubljana bourse since the beginning of the year.
Tosama will list 180,099 shares with a nominal value of 10,000 tolars ($75.8) per share, representing 58.88 percent of the company's equity capital.
Rudis will list 410,267 shares, each with a nominal value of 1,000 tolars, accounting for 68.48 percent of the firm's equity capital.
The bourse said it expected up to 16 further listings of newly privatised companies by the end of this year.
Currently, there are 23 shares traded on the primary and 18 on the OTC market of the Ljubljana bourse. -- Marja Novak, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
